title: Tempests
content:
A powerful elemental that is essentially a living storm.

==Tempests==

*A tempest was bound to the Spire of Idjit ([[19.31]]) in the hopes that it would provide rain, but it is under the thumb of the [[Queen Sinister]] and does not do so. It is used to execute prisoners and the [[Idjits]] harness its lightning for various alchemical and elementalist purposes. The tempest produces tempest spawn, but the Idjits believe that this is a result of tampering with the tempest, not a natural process.
